stem.text: 1-chloro-2-methylbutane reacts with sodium cyanide in ethanol in a nucleophilic substitution reaction.
What is the most likely intermediate or transition state in this reaction?

A.alt: Transition state in square brackets with a minus charge. The central carbon is bonded to NC and Cl by dashed bonds, to two H atoms (one hashed, one wedged), and to CH(CH3)CH2CH3 below.

B.alt: Transition state in square brackets with a minus charge. The central carbon is bonded to NC and Cl by dashed bonds, to H3C on a hashed bond, to CH2CH3 on a wedged bond, and to CH3 below.

C.alt: Planar carbocation +C with H3C on a hashed bond, CH2CH3 on a wedged bond, and CH3 below.

D.alt: Planar carbocation +C with H on a hashed bond, H on a wedged bond, and CH(CH3)CH2CH3 below.
